prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1158; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the rear-end collision you were involved in in Sugar Land. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was stopped at a red light on a busy road in Sugar Land, behind a silver sedan. I was waiting for the light to change when I felt a hard jolt from behind. The other vehicle hit my rear bumper.

Q: Had you been stopped for long before the impact?

A: Only a few seconds. The light had just turned red, and I had come to a complete stop.

Q: Did you notice the other driver's speed before the collision?

A: Not really. I was looking forward at the light. I only heard tires and then the impact.

Q: After the collision, what did you do?

A: I stayed in my seat for a minute. My right knee had struck the lower part of the dashboard, and it was throbbing. I got out, checked my car, and exchanged information with the other driver.

Q: Where are you feeling pain now?

A: My right knee is swollen and sore, especially when I bend it or put weight on it. I also have some stiffness in my lower back.

Q: Have you sought medical care since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and was advised to follow up with an orthopedic provider.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?

A: No, I think that covers it. I am willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
